capabilities.name: Command Center Dashboard
capabilities.description: Provide a customizable suite homepage that surfaces creator operations, project state, and quick access to major workflows
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center - Dashboard shell and widget framework
capabilities.notes: The dashboard must reflect real service state and cannot be only decorative UI.

capabilities.name: Widget Framework
capabilities.description: Provide versioned customizable Command Center widgets with layout, resizing, pinning, hiding, grouping, and persistence.
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center - Wave 1.3.1 Dashboard shell and widget framework
capabilities.notes: The framework must support first-party widgets and later permissioned extension-provided widgets.

capabilities.name: Workspace Profiles
capabilities.description: Provide creator-oriented workspace profiles with persistent layout, themes, shortcuts, tool visibility, and extension-stack performances.
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center - Wave 1.3.2 Workspace profiles and session recovery
capabilities.notes: Planned profiles include Writing, Data, Development, Modeling, Animation, Game, Research, and Custom.

capabilities.name: Session Recovery
capabilities.description: Restore open projects, active slices, panel layouts, selected resources, unsaved state, terminals, and task context after restart.
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center — Wave 1.3.2 Workspace profiles and session recovery
capabilities.notes: Session metadata must be recoverable without silently replaying unsafe operations.

capabilities.name: Operational Health Center
capabilities.description: Display project, engine, extension, backup, AI, indexing, synchronization, worker, and system-health state with actionable diagnostics.
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center — Wave 1.3.3 Operational visibility and health center
capabilities.notes: Health statuses must represent actual services and expose ownership, severity, logs, and suggested actions.

capabilities.name: Unified Job and Queue Management
capabilities.description: Present build, render, simulation, conversion, import, export, indexing, update, workflow, and cloud jobs through one queue model.
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center — Wave 1.3.4 Jobs queues tasks and notifications
capabilities.notes: Supported jobs should expose state, progress, priority, logs, outputs, pause or cancellation, retry, and recovery.

capabilities.name: Notification Center
capabilities.description: Provide actionable, dismissible, grouped, searchable notifications tied to suite operations and affected resources.
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center — Wave 1.3.4 Jobs queues tasks and notifications
capabilities.notes: A later CORE pass may promote shared notification infrastructure into its own dedicated capability.

capabilities.name: Global Resource Search
capabilities.description: Search major project and suite resources including files, symbols, documents, cells, assets, scenes, shots, workflows, settings, extensions, and help.
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center — Wave 1.3.5 Global search command palette and operational shortcuts
capabilities.notes: Search depends on project and asset metadata and will later consume the shared indexing system.

capabilities.name: Global Command Palette
capabilities.description: Provide searchable commands with aliases, favorites, recent and frequent commands, categories, permissions, context, and operational shortcuts.
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center — Wave 1.3.5 Global search command palette and operational shortcuts
capabilities.notes: Major actions should report status and support cancellation where the underlying command supports it.

capabilities.name: Workflow Overview and Editor
capabilities.description: Provide workflow creation, library access, validation, dry-run preview, run monitoring, logs, inputs, outputs, and failure visibility.
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center — Wave 1.3.6 Workflow overview editor diagnostics and monitoring
capabilities.notes: This is the initial operational workflow surface that later terminal, CLI, extension, AI, and cloud systems build upon.

capabilities.name: Command Center Safe Recovery
capabilities.description: Allow the Command Center to open in a recoverable safe state when widgets, extensions, services, or previous session state fail.
capabilities.source: v1.3 Creator Command Center — Validation and public-beta release gate
capabilities.notes: A failing widget or extension must not prevent access to recovery controls.
